title: 第8章 龙村劫难

content_zh:
“小畜生，除非你能上天入地，不被我逮到，不然将你挫骨扬灰，师妹，走！”火世面沉如水，双眸杀机涌动，快速跃上鸟背。
刘燕叹息，跟了上去，她本不想做的太绝，但事已至此，唯有杀人灭口，方才能了事。
火烈鸟冲天而起，悬浮在河流上空，火世目光犀利，扫视着每一个角落。
滚滚河水，猛浪若奔，急湍似箭!
“好，好，没想到我火世居然上了你的当。”扫视着如马奔腾的河流，并无一人，火世咬牙切齿，愤怒道。
“师兄，现在怎么办，无天逃走，显然是已经知道我们的用心，若是让他逃走，把令牌的秘密泄露出去，我们岂不是再也没机会。”
火世脸色阴沉，寒声道：“逃得过和尚逃不过庙，河流汹涛，想必他被河水冲到了下流，我们沿着河流寻找，必能找到他，到时定叫他生不如死。”
“走。”
“啾！”得到命令，火烈鸟鸣叫一声，沿着河流下端飞去。
“呱！”
就在火世两人离去不久，河流中一声蛙鸣响起，却见一头拳头大的魔蛙浮出水面，狭长的双目，四周扫视一圈，灵动非凡，而后又沉入水中。
不多时，湍流的河水出现一道漩涡，漩涡中心处，一颗脑袋钻出水面，警戒的四处看了看，见四周没人，一跃而起。
“小家伙，快走。”跃上岸边，无天快速跑进密林，一头扎了进去。
“呱。”
“别吵。”无天捂住小天的嘴，躲在灌木中，望着天空。
不多时，啾的一声，火烈鸟载着火世两人卷土重来，相隔老远，无天都能感觉到，一股森然的杀机。
“师兄，他是不是已经被淹死，或者被水兽杀死了。”刘燕眉头深皱，轻叹道：“唉，令牌没抢到，人也死了，这下回去要怎么交代呀！”
火世道：“这件事事关重大，活要见人，死要见尸，我们再详细搜寻一遍，不要放过每一寸地方。如果还没找到，就血洗龙村，让所有的一切都灰飞烟灭，特别是龙河，然后再派人前来打捞，一定要得到那东西。”
火世十分恼火，早知道无天这么精明，就应该等回到宗门后，再行打算，可现在已经来不及，唯有杀了村子所有人，湮灭一切证据，才能守住这个秘密。
“唉！枉造杀孽。”刘燕于心不忍。

火世瞥了她一眼，道：“走！”
待火世两人离去，无天探出脑袋，若有所思的想了一阵，转身奔进密林，朝着龙村而去。
他要去弄清楚，令牌到底是什么，龙河为何要怎么做。
而心里也滋生出一丝杀机，两次都因龙河差点丢掉性命，泥菩萨也有三丈火，何况是一个人。
龙河有脱胎小成期的修为，但如今废去一只手，实际战力恐怕只堪当于脱胎初成期，无天全力出手，再加上小天的配合，绝对能将其毙命。
这是无天从小到大，第一次对一个人产生杀机，同时也渐渐懂了人心的复杂，虽说人性使然，心有欲望不为过，但这次龙河的做法，真真切切惹怒了他。
两天后。
无天站在一座山峰上，眺望远方，终于看见了龙村模糊的轮廓，这一路妖兽颇多，但有小天在，却也有惊无险。
“还是骑乘火烈鸟好啊，看似短短的几百里，居然走了两天。”无天浑身污垢，尚有未干枯的血迹，黑发一撮一撮黏在一起，坐在一块青石上，感叹道。
几百里路程，若是骑乘火烈鸟，只在两个时辰左右，而步行却花了两天时间，这不得不让无天感慨不已，当然，若不是一路上有各种妖兽拦路，也用不了这么久。
“呱！”小天蛙鸣，像是在回应。
“小家伙，还有几十来里路程，我们快点赶路。”
抱起小天，无天正欲起身离去，然而这时一道尖锐的鸟鸣传来，让他如受惊的兔子，咻的一下窜进草丛中，隐匿起来。
片刻间，一只火烈鸟呼啸而过，散着阵阵炎热，而鸟背上则站着一男一女，这两人正是火世与刘燕。
无天站了起来，狐疑嘀咕：“他们这是去哪？”
“不好，他们的目标是村子。”无天面色大变，犹如火烧屁股般，朝着龙村疾驰而去。
龙村如往常般，鸡犬声鸣，祥和安宁。
空地上，那些没有开启体魄的孩子，正努力挥舞着拳头，浑身大汗挥洒，却没有停歇，准备来年一定要开启体魄，成为俢者。

content_en:
"Little beast, unless you can go to heaven and earth without being caught by me, I will crush you to ashes. Junior sister, let's go!" Huo Shi's face was as dark as water, his eyes were filled with murderous intent, and he quickly jumped on the bird's back.
Liu Yan sighed and followed. She didn't want to do anything too extreme, but the matter had come to this, and the only way to end the matter was to kill someone and silence them.
The flamingos soared into the sky and hung above the river. Fire World's sharp eyes scanned every corner.
The river is rolling, the waves are rushing, and the rapids are like arrows!
"Okay, okay, I didn't expect that I, Huo Shi, would be fooled by you." Looking at the galloping river, there was no one there. Huo Shi gritted his teeth and said angrily.
"Senior brother, what should we do now? Wutian has escaped and obviously knows our intentions. If he escapes and leaks the secret of the token, won't we never have a chance again?"
Huo Shi's face was gloomy and he said in a cold voice: "A monk can't escape from the temple. The river is turbulent. He must have been washed downstream by the river. We will search along the river and we will definitely find him. When the time comes, his life will be worse than death."
"Let's go."
"Chirp!" After receiving the order, the flamingo chirped and flew along the lower end of the river.
"Quack!"
Not long after the two people from the Fire World left, a frog croaked in the river, and a fist-sized devil frog surfaced. Its long and narrow eyes glanced around with extraordinary agility, and then sank into the water again.
Not long after, a whirlpool appeared in the turbulent river. In the center of the whirlpool, a head emerged from the water. He looked around warily and saw no one around, so he jumped up.
"Little guy, let's go." Jumping onto the shore, Wutian quickly ran into the dense forest and plunged into it.
"Quack."
"Don't make any noise." Wutian covered Xiaotian's mouth, hid in the bushes, and looked at the sky.
Not long after, there was a chirping sound, and the flamingo carried the two people from the Fire World back. Even though they were far apart, Wutian could feel a strong murderous intention.
"Brother, has he been drowned or killed by a water beast?" Liu Yan frowned deeply and sighed softly: "Oh, I didn't get the token and the person died. How should I explain it when I go back!"
Huo Shidao: "This matter is of great importance. We need to see the person alive and the body after death. Let's search in detail again and don't miss every inch. If we haven't found it yet, we will bloodbath Long Village and let everything be wiped out, especially Long River. Then we will send people to salvage it and we must get that thing."
Huo Shi was very angry. If he had known that Wu Tian was so shrewd, he should have waited until he returned to the sect before making plans. But now it was too late. He could only keep this secret by killing everyone in the village and annihilating all evidence.
"Alas! It was a waste of time to commit murder." Liu Yan couldn't bear it.
Huo Shi glanced at her and said, "Let's go!"
After Huo Shi and the two left, Wu Tian stuck his head out, thought thoughtfully for a while, turned around and ran into the dense forest, heading towards Long Village.
He wanted to find out what the token was and why Long He did what he did.
There was also a trace of murderous intention in his heart. He almost lost his life because of Long He twice. The Clay Bodhisattva also had three feet of fire, let alone a person.
Long He has the cultivation level of the reborn stage, but now that one of his hands is gone, his actual combat power is probably only equivalent to that of the reborn stage. Wutian's full attack, coupled with Xiaotian's cooperation, can definitely kill him.
This was the first time Wu Tian had murderous intentions towards a person since he was a child. At the same time, he gradually understood the complexity of the human heart. Although it is human nature to have desires, Long He's actions this time really angered him.
Two days later.
Wutian stood on a mountain peak, looked into the distance, and finally saw the vague outline of Longcun. There were many monsters along the way, but with Xiaotian around, there was no danger.
"It's better to ride a flamingo. It seemed like a short few hundred miles, but it actually took two days." Wutian was covered in dirt and still had blood stains that had not dried up. His black hair was stuck together in bunches, and he sat on a piece of bluestone and sighed.
Hundreds of miles away,If riding a flamingo, it would only take about two hours, but it would take two days on foot, which had to make Wutian sigh. Of course, if there were not various monsters blocking the way along the way, it would not have taken so long.
"Quack!" Xiaotian frog croaked, as if in response.
"Little guy, there are still dozens of miles to go, let's hurry up."
After picking up Xiaotian, Wutian was about to get up and leave, but then a sharp bird song came, making him scurry into the grass and hide like a frightened rabbit.
In a moment, a flamingo roared past, exuding bursts of heat, and on the back of the bird stood a man and a woman. These two people were Huo Shi and Liu Yan.
Wutian stood up and muttered suspiciously: "Where are they going?"
"No, their target is the village." Wutian's expression changed drastically, and he rushed towards Longcun as if his butt was on fire.
Longcun is as usual, with chickens and dogs crowing, peaceful and peaceful.
In the open space, those children who have not activated their bodies are waving their fists hard, sweating profusely, but they have not stopped, preparing to activate their bodies in the coming year and become warriors.
